blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – On Day 25 of the impeachment trial, an Ombudsman records officer testified that VP Sara Duterte declared no cash on hand or in bank from 2019 to 2025, as prosecutors used her own Statements of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALNs) to allege unexplained wealth. Tuesday’s trial focused on Duterte’s SALNS, with the prosecution calling Ombudsman Records Division officer-in-charge lawyer Karen Batu as its second witness for Article II of the impeachment complaint.
